outlook.statement: Cement production target of 2,70,000 MT for current year; Sugar cane crushing target revised downwards to 25,000 MT; Power division performance to remain low due to dependence on sugar division and lack of government policy allowing coal as alternative fuel to bagasse.

Given the fact that the cement industry is displaying bright prospects and the longstanding reputation the Company enjoys in the market, we are expecting that there would be better performance in the days to come.
Division-wise outlook has been furnished elsewhere in this Report.

The Company is desirous of reaping the benefits of its well positioned dealer network across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh for its cement plant and will make every effort to overcome bottlenecks in achieving targeted operations for the current year.

The Company will make its best endeavors in resolving the complicated issues in the sugar and power divisions through negotiations with governmental authorities and liaison with legal advisers regarding pending litigations concerning the power division.
Management expects finance cost to be incurred for the year ending 31st March, 2027 is 287.03 Lakhs
